name: AutomationDirect C0-08SIM controller input simulator
aliases: AutomationDirect C0-08SIM controller input simulator GA
summary: C0-08SIM controller input simulator arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: C0-08SIM is the drawing identifier for controller input simulator in AutomationDirect's CLICK PLCs collection. An input simulator lets a technician provide selected test input conditions to a compatible controller arrangement. It is a testing interface rather than a field-sensor input module for permanent process wiring.

For example, in a workshop controller test setup before field wiring is connected, use the C0-08SIM reference to coordinate test controls, compatible controller connection and access for removal. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/CLICK/C0-08SIM.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep test controls, compatible controller connection and access for removal visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named C0-08SIM drawing and its controller input simulator role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
